holds.name: escape_regex/glob_to_regex dynamic operands
holds.evidence: OVAL 5.12.3 FunctionGroup admits object/Variable components, but the active 0.4.1 variable-expression schema has no corresponding expression variant.
holds.required_action: Owner-reviewed canonical 0.4.1 representation before production conversion; do not encode a converter-private function envelope or silently materialize dynamic values.

proof_limits: This is a grammar crosswalk, not scanner qualification.
Runtime collection/status behavior remains unproved even for representable operations.
No source content was edited and no deprecated operation was enabled.

canonical_requirements.scope: minimal dynamic escape_regex and glob_to_regex additions to canonical SCAP-NG 0.4.1 variable-expression grammar

semantics: evaluate one operand per produced value
escape OVAL Perl-compatible regex metacharacters without changing source order or multiplicity
propagate missing/error/unknown/incomplete/not-collected/not-applicable status; never stringify diagnostic status
negative_witnesses: native record-valued operand (must fail closed rather than flatten)

semantics: evaluate one operand per produced value
preserve glob_noescape default and exact OVAL glob-to-regex lexical behavior
bound output bytes and population before materialization
propagate diagnostic statuses and report malformed glob as error
preserve OVAL slash separator, dotfile, dot-directory, case, brace and tilde behavior

canonical_requirements.converter_obligation: Do not emit either dynamic form until the canonical schema requirement is approved and pinned. Keep current bounded static-literal conversion and explicit source disposition.
ri_obligations: execute each operation over collected values with bounded item/byte/resource budgets
preserve source ordering, multiplicity and collection status in canonical Results
use a trusted, profile-approved regex implementation; no shell fallback or unbounded helper
record source function identity, pattern/glob provenance, timing, truncation and decisive error reason
add positive, negative, empty, malformed, diagnostic-status and resource-limit runtime tests before qualification
